lines: BCU has grown from approximately $5.8 billion (2023) to $6.24 billion in total assets by Q3 2025 [E-005, E-007:F1], maintaining steady expansion in a challenging rate environment. Member count surpassed 364,000, driven by the SEG acquisition pipeline of 1.2 million eligible members through employer partnerships [E-038:F1]. Net worth ratio at 10.16% provides a comfortable capital buffer well above NCUA requirements [E-007:F3]. CDO Guglani has described a strategic shift from "lending-focused" to "deposit and digital-first" [E-016:F3], indicating that BCU's investment thesis is moving toward platform capability — a signal that aligns directly with Salesforce ecosystem expansion and creates receptivity for Data Cloud and MuleSoft conversations.

firmographics.narrative_md: Baxter Credit Union (BCU) is a $6.24 billion federally insured credit union headquartered in Vernon Hills, Illinois, serving 364,000+ members across all 50 states and Puerto Rico through a distinctive employer-endorsed (SEG) model with partners including Target, HCA Healthcare, GEICO, and UnitedHealth Group [E-001, E-002, E-038]. BCU has made one of the deepest Salesforce commitments in the credit union sector — 9 products deployed including Agentforce, Financial Services Cloud, and Marketing Cloud — and operates 5 AI systems in production [E-006, E-046]. CDO John Sahagian describes BCU as taking "exciting first steps to become an agentic enterprise" [E-046:F4], signaling strategic alignment with Salesforce's platform direction. This research identified three confirmed-absent Zennify-priority platforms (Data Cloud, MuleSoft, CRM Analytics) that address gaps BCU's own leadership has articulated publicly.
